findings.violated_requirement: spec.md User Story 2, FR-008 and SC-002; plan.md FR-008 validation; CLI contract rejection channels; speckit-tasks requires each story to contain its necessary implementation and requested tests with valid dependencies.
findings.observed_deficiency: Phase 4 contains independent test prose but no executable checklist tasks. T008 and T009 do not exist, although dependencies, requirement coverage, parallel examples and strategy reference them. T007 covers successful CLI flow; generic later validation T010-T012 does not assign implementation of read/decode rejection handling or its concrete unit/subprocess rejection matrix. Thus missing paths, directories and undecodable input have no story implementation/test tasks establishing status 2, category stderr and zero stdout.
findings.exact_correction: Restore unchecked T008 [US2] rejection tests in tests/test_normalize_text.py before unchecked T009 [US2] error handling in normalize_text.py. T008 must cover missing paths, directories, invalid UTF-8 including a valid prefix then invalid bytes, zero/two arguments and ordinary OS read failure, asserting status 2, category stderr and empty stdout. T009 must implement those approved argument/read/decode error paths with no partial stdout or fallback decoding. Preserve T001 exact completed row and all existing IDs/markers; align dependency and coverage references to the restored tasks. Preserve reviewed spec/design decisions; implement no code during task repair.
